frames.step_name: Set the floating head and back
frames.visible_job: Draws the rounded head with two attached ears and continues one long back curve down-left.
frames.instruction: Near the upper right, draw one rounded head with two small ear bumps. From behind the lower ear, sweep one relaxed back curve diagonally toward the lower left and stop where the tail will begin.

frames.visible_job: Adds the broad belly contour, pale inner belly boundary, and one attached tapering tail.
frames.instruction: Start under the chin and bow a broad belly curve down-left, keeping the middle roomy. Join it to one tapering tail that continues from the back curve and ends in a soft point, then add a pale inner belly boundary from the chest toward the tail base.
adds: belly body tail and pale belly boundary
introduces: belly body tail and pale belly boundary

frames.visible_job: Adds two small forepaws together on the belly and two attached hind paws with three toe marks each.
frames.instruction: Place exactly two small forepaws touching over the middle of the belly. Attach two rounded hind paws near the lower body, then add three short toe marks inside each hind paw.

frames.step_name: Add the otter face and fur
frames.visible_job: Adds the eyes, nose, mouth, six whiskers, and small face and coat fur accents.
frames.instruction: Add two small eyes, one dark rounded nose, and a short mouth seam. Pull exactly three whiskers from each cheek, then add a few short fur strokes at the cheeks, chest, body edge, and tail without moving the pale belly boundary.

frames.visible_job: Adds three broken ripple groups, the soft shadow, and both eye highlights before color.
frames.instruction: Draw exactly three broken ripple groups around the body without crossing the paws or tail. Shade one soft broken shadow beneath the otter, then preserve one tiny open-paper highlight inside each eye.
adds: three water ripples and broken shadow
introduces: three water ripples and broken shadow

final_step.visible_job: Adds restrained warm-brown, tan, gray, and pale-blue color only inside the established drawing.
final_step.instruction: Layer warm-brown pencil over the coat, pale tan inside the established muzzle and belly boundary, cool gray through the existing shadow, and pale blue over the same three ripple groups. Keep graphite and paper tooth visible and add no new contours.
adds: restrained river color on established forms
